title: ExecutionTask
description: ENG-01 new contract for the existing SA object (SA 03/08.2 ExecutionTask; SA SM-01). A Work commonly owns multiple ExecutionTasks; each ExecutionTask keeps one stable operation/business_key for its whole lifetime (ADR 0001: 對外 execution_id 指向它；原 SA /tasks/{id} 保持此語意). A retry never allocates a new ExecutionTask -- it only appends an ExecutionAttempt (see execution-attempt.schema.json).

TaskLease.description: SD §2/§6.3: fence_token monotonically increases per lease; an expired holder must not create a new external action.

kind.description: SD §2: root task may be GROUP, coordinating only already-approved manifest children; every real external side effect belongs to an ACTION task. GROUP never calls external write APIs directly.

parent_task_id.description: Must be the same tenant_id and Work as this task (SD §2); enforcing the no-cycle, same-Work invariant across a task graph is ENG-02 persistence/test scope.

operation.description: Capability key family, e.g. booking.create, refund.create (consistent with connector-result-and-reconciliation.md §2 capability_key naming).

request_hash.description: Hash of request_snapshot; same business_key with a different request_hash is rejected at the persistence layer (409, SD §6.1).

request_snapshot.description: The actual business content that passed schema validation. Credentials, cookies and raw card data must never appear here (SD §2).

status.description: SD §4. PARTIAL is only valid for a GROUP task aggregating child ACTION results.

postcondition.description: Named, versioned success condition the verifier checks before DONE (SD §4/§7). Never a free-text phrase a model could rewrite to appear satisfied.

authorization_use_id.description: Present once this task has consumed an AuthorizationUse (SD authorization-and-approval.md §5); absent while still DRAFT/NEW for operations that need one.

manifest_item_id.description: SD authorization-and-approval.md §5: the one scope_manifest item_id (ApprovalRecord/ExecutionAuthorization) this task is executing. Required alongside authorization_use_id on a kind='ACTION' task (see allOf below) so the pre-dispatch check can confirm operation/resource/version/channel/account/amount/purpose/expiry all come from this exact manifest item, not a different one in the same approval. A kind='GROUP' root task may carry authorization_use_id for the whole manifest without a single manifest_item_id; its children's manifest_item_id values are what the manifest is actually scoped to.

allOf.description: SD authorization-and-approval.md §5: only a child ACTION task consuming an AuthorizationUse must pin the single scope_manifest item_id it is executing. A GROUP root task consumes the AuthorizationUse for the whole manifest and coordinates multiple manifest items, so it is never required to carry one manifest_item_id itself.
